description: Walk the tideline at the waterfront when the tide is out and see what shells it has left on the wet stones: cockles, limpets, periwinkles, scallops, razor shells and rarer finds. Every tide, about every twelve hours, brings a different handful. With "take", pick one up and keep it as a souvenir. Nothing is stored.

take.description: Optional: the id of a shell on the tideline now (from looking first), to pick it up and keep it.

name: look_for_shells
title: Look for shells on the tideline
